response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL THEN spent END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL THEN amount END), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), a AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r) SELECT r.event_id, r.spend_ratio, r.spend_ratio / NULLIF(a.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM r, a ORDER BY (r.spend_ratio / NULLIF(a.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
